Birthday Celebration

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Plan a birthday ride around the guest list, dinner, activities, and one scheduled return. Cabin style ranges from quiet executive seating to party lighting for larger celebrations.

Request a quoteCall to reserve

Prices start at $145 an hour for the Executive Black Sprinter, which seats 14, on a 4-hour minimum, so the shortest booking is $580 before 8% tax. Every vehicle is booked by the hour at its published rate and minimum, with no per-seat pricing.

Frequently asked questions

Can you help coordinate a surprise?

Submit the proposed reveal time, location, organizer contact, and any decoration request. The team will review the plan and list accepted details in the written confirmation.

What ages do you serve?

Trip requests can be submitted for age-appropriate celebrations. Passenger, guardian, and alcohol requirements are reviewed for the selected vehicle and confirmed in writing.

Can we do dinner AND nightlife?

A dinner-to-nightlife route can be requested. Book venues directly, then share the confirmed stops and return time so transportation timing can be reviewed.
